title: Back in Chicago the Wolverines break up
summary: A reshuffled band plays the Rendezvous and Valentino Inn before breaking up.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: However, we did go back to Chicago outside of the drummer and the clarinet player, Jimmy Hartwell and Vic Moore. And Dick Voynow, we got, what did we get, I've forgotten, Oh Jimmy Lord, Jimmy Lord that's right. Lloyd on clarinet and oh, Frank, oh what was his name, on drums. And we worked a couple of jobs at the Rendezvous on the North Side and the Valentino Inn downtown and the band broke up, at that time.
Now was your brother in Florida with you?
No. No that was just, Bob Gilette was on banjo.
Did he ever work with you after that?
